chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn 'Atiyyah, from Sulayman, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The slanderer is flogged in the case of mutual imprecation.

key_terms.لِلْمُلَاعَنَةِ: in the case of mutual imprecation between spouses
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: is to be flogged; denotes the prescribed corporal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the accuser in the case of mula'anah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning qadhf (false accusation of unchastity) in relation to mula'anah. It indicates that the one who makes the accusation is subject to flogging in that legal context.
